spec.title: Presentation checklist
spec.description: Measured observations only. Missing telemetry is not zero. See the measurement contract.

options.content:
1. Confirm real LLM mode and baseline replacement.  
2. Confirm traces, logs, metrics, browser and profile links.  
3. Confirm all three coding sources are authentic; read price coverage.  
4. Confirm candidate experiment verdicts and sample counts.  
5. Enable one leased fault; explain the evidence; reset and rerun.  
**Unavailable signal ≠ successful check.** Saved evidence must be labelled as saved.
